column2: A tall elf in white and gold stood at your gate this morning, a great halberd in hand and a cloak of phoenix feathers across the shoulders. The guard spoke not a single word. Your steward says the Phoenix Guard are sworn to silence, for in the Chamber of Days each of them has seen the hour of their own death. The guard handed over a scroll sealed with the flame of Asuryan and walked away.\n\nThe letter is short. The Isle of Flame and the Shrine of Asuryan belong to the Asur and their god. You are to leave the isle before the season turns. If you do not, the Phoenix Guard will come for it, and they already know how the battle ends.
We will leave the isle to its keepers.
Let them come and see if their visions are true.
